info.description: Bounded simulator subset of the official AWS Direct Connect API (2012-10-25). Every other official operation returns HTTP 501 UnknownOperationException. Direct Connect gateways are stored records: no connection, interconnect, link aggregation group, virtual interface, BGP session or routing exists, and a gateway forwards no traffic. Gateways are available at once and are visible from every Region, as AWS documents, and deleting one removes it at once (the delete response reports deleted). Every connection, LAG, virtual interface, hosted connection, location, letter of authorization, router configuration, test and dependent-resource API returns UnknownOperationException with HTTP 501. Gateway associations and association proposals are not bound: an association would claim that a virtual private gateway or transit gateway of another service is attached and ready to pass traffic, which this record store cannot check. DescribeTags is not bound because it addresses many ARNs in one request; tags are returned in the tags member of each gateway instead. amazonSideAsn defaults to 64512 and must be 64512 to 65534 or 4200000000 to 4294967294; it cannot be changed after creation. Gateway names are not required to be unique, as in AWS. DescribeDirectConnectGateways returns an empty list for an identifier that does not exist, and a missing gateway in other operations fails with DirectConnectClientException.
